name: Grand Pharmaceutical Group Limited
summary: Grand Pharmaceutical Group Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of pharmaceutical preparations and medical devices, biotechnology and healthcare products, and pharmaceutical raw materials. The company offers respiratory, ophthalmology, cerebro-cardiovascular emergency, and biotechnology related products. It manufactures and sells pharmaceutical, taurine, agrochemicals, chemical medicine, and amino acid series products. In addition, the company provides bio-pesticides and additives; disposal surgical products; and Chinese medicine, and health food products.
